overview_description.description:
EvenUp is the leading proactive AI platform for personal injury law firms. Firms such as Lerner & Rowe, Malman Law, and J&Y Law use EvenUp's AI-native capabilities to orchestrate workflows across the full case lifecycle: intake, treatment tracking, medical record and bill retrieval, medical chronologies, damages valuation, demands, negotiations, discovery, and trial preparation. 

Built on the largest personal injury dataset and backed by in-house legal and medical experts, EvenUp helps firms take on more cases, move them faster, and resolve them at higher value without adding headcount.

EvenUp is used by 30% of the top 100 PI firms and applied across more than 10,000 cases a week representing over $14 billion in damages.

about_short_description.short_description: EvenUp is the leading proactive AI platform for personal injury firms, supporting the entire case lifecycle from intake through resolution.

product.name: Claims Intelligence Platform™
product.description: A case-management and legal-work automation platform for personal injury firms, covering intake, treatment, demands, negotiation, discovery, and trial preparation.

product.name: Piai™
product.description: EvenUp’s personal-injury AI system that extracts, reconciles, and analyzes case information from medical records and legal documents to produce case-grounded outputs.

product.name: Pre-Litigation as a Service (PLAAS™)
product.description: A managed pre-litigation service that combines EvenUp’s software and professional support to coordinate personal injury case work before a lawsuit is filed.

product.name: Demands™
product.description: A demand-package solution that uses personal injury case data to draft settlement demands, summarize injuries and damages, and organize supporting exhibits.

product.name: Medical Management™
product.description: A treatment-coordination and medical-record management solution that tracks care, identifies missing records, and organizes treatment information for personal injury cases.

product.name: Workflow Automation™
product.description: An AI workflow system that applies configurable playbooks to personal injury cases, surfaces case insights, and automates routine actions.
